persistence.basis: PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md preserve the approved journey-v3 native world; docs/desktop/WALKTHROUGH.md records the new interaction and event contract. This is a code-led extension with no new comp or concept-roll obligation.
persistence.evidence: All eight required PNGs exist, were visually opened, and show their named states without malformed or blank capture regions. JSON diagnostics and provenance were inspected. No native design detector ran.
persistence.scope: Wide captures are 1440×731 native frames; compact captures are 720×500, with approval at 720×504. Exact 720×480 light-window behavior is not certified. Review samples WalkthroughView.swift, WalkthroughState.swift, and their WorkspaceWindow/RuntimeClient integration. Backend and engine sources were not independently reviewed; reported tests were not rerun. Provider/OAuth, executed approval commands, production owner-lock recovery, full keyboard/IME/VoiceOver acceptance, and release readiness remain outside this review.

matrix.evidence: System prose, familiar control typography, and restrained size/weight hierarchy match the explicitly approved AppKit identity. Monospace stays in code evidence.
Native chrome, semantic surfaces, SF Symbols, table disclosures, and standard controls carry the interface; no simulated physical material or decorative card system.
Light and dark native grounds follow DESIGN.md's semantic AppKit appearance authority; no fixed-color comp governs this extension.
Wide views retain left navigation, dominant central conversation/composer, and secondary right context. Current stage and inspectable work are immediately recognizable.

As specified by the compact-window contract, the sidebar hides and secondary explanations yield to activity and actions. The persistent composer and approval actions remain visible at the captured native frames.

Live capture follows active work despite queued work; history capture pins the completed instruction. File capture opens the real read-only preview in Code while chat remains visible. Targeted source supports the selection rules and existing navigation callbacks.

Failure exposes literal Exit 1 and recovery guidance; approval says paused; recovery says interrupted with no completion recorded. Synthetic fixture text is explicit. Command evidence and human review remain separate from success claims.

Native indeterminate feedback has no invented percentage. Diagnostics show live animation and stopped history, reduced-motion, approval, failure, and recovered states; source also gates hidden/offline indicators. Static images do not certify animation timing or production behavior.

fidelity.contract: THESIS: conversation-led observation holds. OWN-WORLD: native AppKit conventions hold. STORY: follow, inspect, review, and recover remain legible. FIRST VIEWPORT: chat remains dominant with composer available. FORM: approved journey-v3 topology persists; no new visual-world seed is applicable.
fidelity.floor: No material native craft-floor violation in the reviewed inspector and integration.

ceiling: reached — the native quality bar is served by semantic controls, inspectable activity, explicit failure/approval states, and restrained functional motion; no additional decorative device is warranted.
keep: Preserve the dominant chat/composer, explicit follow-versus-pinned selection, honest stage/evidence language, native semantics, and focus-preserving secondary inspector.
